IS 13606 : 2013 Synthetic Sulphochlorinated Fatliquors for Leather Processing - SpecificationICS 59.140.10CHD 171 SCOPEThis standard prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and test for synthetic fatliquors of sulphochlorinated type used for leather processing.2 REFERENCESThe following standards contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below.1070 : 1992 Reagent grade water - Specification (third revision)1640 : 2007 Glossary of terms relating to hides, skins and leather (first revision)4905 : 1968 Methods for random sampling14575 : 1999 Determination of pentachlorophenol (PCP) in leather - Method of test
